summary: ICL Group Ltd. (an Israeli chemicals company) filed a Form 6-K furnishing a supplemental dividend report, disclosing the per-share dividend amount (US$0.05811, or ILS 0.1750273) payable to shareholders of record as of September 2, 2026, with a payment date of September 16, 2026. The filing updates a prior August 5, 2026 announcement about a ~$75 million total dividend. It also describes Israeli withholding-tax rates applicable to the distribution, noting portions allocated to different shareholder classes and treaty-based reductions. This is an ordinary routine dividend disclosure, not a special-situation event.
